<infobox theme="Media">
	<image source="image"></image>
    <title source="title"></title>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Production information</header>
        <data source="developer"><label>Developer(s)</label></data>
        <data source="publisher"><label>Publisher(s)</label></data>
        <data source="release date"><label>Release date</label><format><!--
        -->{{#ifeq:{{lc:{{{release date|}}}}}|none||{{#ifeq:{{lc:{{{release date|}}}}}|future||{{{release date|}}}}}}}<!--
        --></format></data>
        <data source="closed"><label>Date closed</label></data>
        <data source="upc"><label>[[Wikipedia:Universal Product Code|UPC]]</label></data>
        <data source="engine"><label>Game engine</label></data>	
        <data source="genre"><label>Genre</label></data>
        <data source="modes"><label>Modes</label></data>	
        <data source="ratings"><label>Rating(s)</label></data>	
        <data source="platforms"><label>Platform(s)</label></data>
        <data source="series"><label>Series</label></data>
        <data source="basegame"><label>Base game</label></data>	
        <data source="expansions"><label>Expansion(s)</label></data>	     
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
        <header>Attribution information</header>
        <data source="director"><label>Director(s)</label></data>
        <data source="producer"><label>Producer(s)</label></data>
        <data source="designer"><label>Designer(s)</label></data>
        <data source="programmer"><label>Programmer(s)</label></data>
        <data source="artist"><label>Artist(s)</label></data>
        <data source="writer"><label>Writer(s)</label></data>
        <data source="composer"><label>Composer(s)</label></data>
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Chronological information</header>
        <data source="timeline"><label>Timeline</label></data>
        <data source="prev"><label>Previous</label></data>
        <data source="next"><label>Next</label></data>			
    </group>
	<navigation><small>{{PlainLink|//starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Template:VideoGame|name=<nowiki>[</nowiki>Source<nowiki>]</nowiki>}}</small></navigation>
</infobox>{{PreloadCat}}<!-- TEMPLATE ENDS HERE.

The following code flags infoboxes that do not have parameters defined.

-->{{#invoke:MediaDateCheck|main|no_year_check={{{no_year_check|}}}|template_name=VideoGame}}<includeonly>{{AppMediaCat|not_appearance={{{not_appearance|}}}}}</includeonly><noinclude>

==Usage==
The attribution information parameters (director to composer) are there to feature only the names of the people involved in leadership/major positions.
